ambiguities.basis: Frozen B63 literature-control and cost interfaces.

ambiguities.question: May generic DLP preprocessing be counted as a one-third attack?
ambiguities.resolution: Only with its full preprocessing, advice, memory, online, success, and reuse costs. Query-only exponent is not the campaign objective.
ambiguities.basis: Corrigan-Gibbs--Kogan preprocessing model and the goal's fully charged objective.

attention_contract.decisive_evidence: A concrete selector/transcript and exact source replay with a verified parameter map, achieved success law, and all-axis sub-rho cost, or a reachable collision/obstruction for a named family.
attention_contract.inconclusive_decision: No implementation or execution; identify the cheapest missing interface.
attention_contract.local_ambiguity_rule: Any hidden scalar label, target training, B^3 materialization, unverified source, query-only accounting, success ceiling, or unknown axis used as domination forces REVISE.
attention_contract.rerank_trigger: All three independent reviews and the Coordinator ledger disposition are durably archived.
